name: Takamiya Satsuki
source:
[i]The protagonist's mysterious older sister who controls the dark side of the school.[/i]

A third-year female student at Tatsuryou Academy. She is Ryo's older sister, and like Ryo, she is a descendant of the school's founder. She is a brilliant, sociable, and talented girl.

However, she has a mysterious charisma that never ceases to attract people, and due to her lineage she is famous not only within the school but also outside of it. She is a central figure in the "behind the scenes" of the school, that centers around the old school building.

[Translated from [url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/medorei/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
